label: Client/Project
title: CoreHR provides a comprehensive HR management solution, offering seamless employee tracking, attendance management, payroll processing, and task scheduling—all within an intuitive interface.

blocks.alt: CoreHR logo on a light card next to a photo of a professional sitting in an office

label: Scope of Work
title: The CoreHR design process involved creating core HR features, designing an intuitive interface, and ensuring seamless integration across various departments and functionalities.
lead: The design journey was structured around key phases to ensure a user-centered and functional experience.

items.title: Goals
items.text: Establish a comprehensive HR management system focusing on efficiency and usability.

items.title: Functional
items.text: Address key HR challenges like attendance, payroll, and employee scheduling.

items.title: Research
items.text: Conducted interviews and surveys to understand the specific needs of HR managers and employees.

items.title: User Journey
items.text: Mapped user touchpoints to streamline HR processes and remove bottlenecks.

items.title: Interview
items.text: User-centered interviews to ensure the design aligns with end-user expectations.

blocks.label: Understanding HR Challenges
blocks.text: We conducted comprehensive research to identify the pain points HR teams face, from managing schedules to handling payroll and employee data.

blocks.alt: An HR professional with a clipboard interviewing a candidate across a table

items.title: UX Design
items.text: Focused on a responsive, mobile-friendly interface to cater to on-the-go HR professionals.

items.title: UI Concept
items.text: Clean, modern visual design to emphasize usability and enhance the overall experience.

label: Assistant
title: Ready to simplify your HR tasks? Let's manage your work schedule, take care of payroll, or maybe explore employee data?
lead: The CoreHR assistant provides quick responses to employee inquiries and supports HR teams with managing schedules, payroll, and employee data—all tailored to your company's needs.

blocks.alt: CoreHR dashboard on a desktop monitor with workforce stats, weekly attendance trend and today's priorities

label: Reimagining HR
title: Reimagining HR Simplicity
lead: CoreHR is designed to simplify HR processes and provide a user-friendly experience for HR managers and employees alike.

blocks.alt: CoreHR login screen: Glad to Have You Back! with email, password and Access Your Dashboard button

label: Typography & Colors
title: Satoshi
lead: A modern and highly legible sans-serif font, Satoshi is designed for versatility and functionality across both digital and print mediums. Its clean, geometric lines provide an excellent balance between aesthetics and readability, making it a perfect choice for professional platforms like CoreHR.
